name: Lyo.Book
tagline: Domain contracts for a library catalog: `Book`, optional `BookSeries`, first-class genres/types/formats/identifiers/contributors, chapters, searchable pages, and `IBookStore`.
description: Domain contracts for a work-first library catalog. A `Book` row is one edition (ISBN lives on the book). Optional `BookSeries`, lookup `BookType`/`BookFormat`/`BookGenre` (hierarchical), `BookIdentifier` (catalog-wide unique scheme+normalized value), `BookContributor`, chapters, and page text. Persistence facade is `IBookStore`. Cross-feature Favorite/Tag use `BookEntityTypes` (`Book`, `BookSeries`, `BookGenre`, `BookChapter`). Does not reference Favorite or Tag.
features: **Catalog work.** `Book` with nullable series, type, and format; denormalized `PrimaryAuthor`; hydrated titles, identifiers, contributors, and genres.
**Lookups.** First-class `BookType`, `BookFormat`, and hierarchical `BookGenre` records — not enums or free-form tags.
**Identifiers.** `BookIdentifierSchemes` plus `Normalize` for ISBN digits. Unique `(scheme, normalized_value)` is enforced by the store.
**Pages.** Raw searchable text (not Brotli). Domain `BookPage` has no tsvector. List APIs omit `Text` unless `includeText` is set.

sections.title: `IBookStore` responsibilities
items: **Book.** `SaveBookAsync` upserts the work and replaces titles, identifiers, contributors, and the genre set; recomputes `PrimaryAuthor`. Get by id, slug, or identifier. `SearchBooksAsync` takes `BookQuery` (`FilterBookIds`: null = no filter, empty = no rows; `Take`/`Skip`; optional `FullText`). `DeleteBookAsync` cascades dependents.
**Series.** Save (including series titles). Delete nulls `Book.SeriesId` and `SeriesIndex` and does not delete books.
**Lookups.** Type, format, and genre CRUD. Delete is blocked while referenced. Genre parent cycles are rejected.
**Chapters / pages.** Metadata CRUD. `GetPageTextAsync` / `SavePageTextAsync` own body text and roll up chapter and book word counts. `SearchPagesAsync` returns page hits with snippets.

sections.title: What is deliberately not here
items: File/blob storage for covers and scans. Compose with FileStorage via `CoverImageRef` / `ScanFileRef`.
Favorites, tags, ratings. Attach via `EntityRef` and `BookEntityTypes` at the host.
Physical holdings, checkout, reading progress, Blazor UI.
